title: Head position on an embedded tape
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota$ embed the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and choose a tape index $\mathrm{cap}$, arbitrary initial contents and head positions, lists $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{out}_0$, an initial configuration $c$, and an index $i$ among the original $m$ tapes. In the embedded silent configuration, the head position on tape $\iota(i)$ equals its position on tape $i$ in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
Initial contents for each of the $k$ tapes
Initial head positions for each of the $k$ tapes
